findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_certificate, inspect_domain, act_on_order, build_portfolio_lander · Private data: appraise_domain, compare_domains, search_recorded_sales, verify_certificate, check_domain_availability, inspect_domain, suggest_available_names, check_portfolio_renewals, get_order_status, act_on_order, get_seller_listing, set_listing_terms, prepare_bulk_listing, read_for_sale_page, read_for_sale_dns, build_portfolio_lander · Public sink: inspect_domain, set_listing_terms, prepare_bulk_listing, build_portfolio_lander · Destructive: appraise_domain, compare_domains, run_bracket, find_comparable_sales, verify_certificate, inspect_domain, list_offers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_certificate, inspect_domain, act_on_order, build_portfolio_lander · Private data: appraise_domain, compare_domains, search_recorded_sales, verify_certificate, check_domain_availability, inspect_domain, suggest_available_names, check_portfolio_renewals, get_order_status, act_on_order, get_seller_listing, set_listing_terms, prepare_bulk_listing, read_for_sale_page, read_for_sale_dns, build_portfolio_lander · Public sink: inspect_domain, set_listing_terms, prepare_bulk_listing, build_portfolio_lander · Destructive: appraise_domain, compare_domains, run_bracket, find_comparable_sales, verify_certificate, inspect_domain, list_offers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
